1.text: It was Saturday morning, and Chike was wide awake. He grabbed his crayons and whispered to Zech, "Let's make something out of this world!"

2.text: Zech smiled with excitement and said, "Can we build a rocket?" Chike nodded. "Yes! Great idea! And we can make planets too!"

3.text: Chike and Zech gathered cardboard, tape, foil, and markers. They built a shiny rocket ship and painted lots of colorful planets to hang around the room.

4.text: Zech named the biggest one "Zectune," and Chike called his planet "Chikopia." Their bedroom became a whole new galaxy!

5.text: They made astronaut helmets from cereal boxes and pretended to fly to each planet. "Blast off!" shouted Chike. "Next stop... Chikopia!"

6.text: Zoom! In their imaginations, the rocket flew past Zectune’s swirly rings and all the way around Chikopia. Chike and Zech waved at the stars as they zipped through space.

7.text: That night, Mom and Dad came to see Chike and Zech's space display and were amazed. "Wow, your creativity is truly out of this world!" Mom said, giving them both a big high five.

9.text: 3 big takeaways Word to know galaxy A galaxy is a huge group of stars out in space. Build With What You Have Chike and Zech did not need fancy supplies. They gathered cardboard, tape, foil and markers to build a shiny rocket, painted colorful planets, and even made astronaut helmets out of cereal boxes. Imagination Takes You Anywhere Chike and Zech named their own planets, Zectune and Chikopia, then flew there in their imaginations. Their bedroom became a whole galaxy, and Mom said their creativity was truly out of this world. Try it at home: Turn a cereal box into an astronaut helmet or paint a paper planet, give your planet its own name, then show your space display to your family.
